title: Fanout bound after sealing
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, gates in topological order, and a designated output vertex. If every vertex of $C$ is read by at most two gates and its output vertex is read by at most one gate, then every vertex of the sealed circuit is read by at most two gates.
